data.one_liner: Validate video URLs from popular platforms like YouTube, Facebook, Vimeo, Dailymotion, and Wistia.
data.what_it_does: Provides a VideoURLValidator class with methods to validate specific video platform URLs such as YouTube, Facebook, Vimeo, Dailymotion, and Wistia. It helps ensure user-submitted or fetched video links match expected formats for popular streaming platforms.
use_when: You need to validate video link inputs in forms or user-submitted content.
Your application embeds or links to videos from YouTube, Vimeo, Facebook, Dailymotion, or Wistia.
avoid_when: You need to validate arbitrary URLs that do not belong to the supported video platforms.
You require playback, downloading, or streaming functionality rather than simple URL validation.
strengths: Supports multiple popular video platforms out of the box.
Simple and straightforward API usage with no external package dependencies.
weaknesses: Limited to five specific video platforms.
Only provides validation methods, no video fetching or metadata extraction.
